description: The figure is a two-level donut chart representing counts for different instruction-related categories, with an inner ring summarizing three broader groups and an outer ring showing eight specific categories with numeric values. The outer ring contains 8 slices labeled Triggering (light blue, 100), Recursive Reasoning (bright blue, 110), Dynamic Environment (dark blue, 100), Memorization (light cyan, 100), Dynamic Instruction (teal, 100), Multitasking (green-teal, 160), Privacy Protection (red, 111), Personalization (salmon, 100), and Prioritization (light pink, 100); these values imply approximate shares of about 11% each for the 100-count slices, ~12% for 110, ~12% for 111, and ~18% for 160. The inner ring contains 3 slices labeled Context Tracking (dark slate blue), Context Retrieving (dark teal), and Contradiction Resolution (brown), with no explicit percentages shown for these inner segments. Labels for the outer slices are placed outside the chart with leader lines and include the numeric counts, while the inner labels are placed inside their segments; no separate legend is shown, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond the ring separation.
